title: Shapes become things
narration: Remember our earlier shapes? Cubes became boxes, spheres became apples, and cylinders became cups.

title: Meet the cone
narration: Today, let's try the cone: a round base that rises to a point.

title: Can you spot the cone?
narration: You'll spot it in an ice-cream cone, a party hat, and the pointed nose of a rocket.

title: Start with the big shape
narration: Watch your teacher build the big shape first, then curve the base into an ellipse.

title: Let the light shape it
narration: Add light and shadow, and those flat marks start to feel round.

title: Your turn!
narration: Another simple shape, so many possibilities. Grab your pencil. Let's give it a go!
